sentences.en: But, she has never offered much excitement in the bedroom.
sentences.zh: 但她卧室里从来没有什么刺激。

sentences.en: I like to have a full-length mirror in my bedroom.

sentences.en: The following day he was found dead in the bedroom.
sentences.zh: 第二天，人们在他的卧室里发现了他的尸体。
